snippet.title: Destruction Derby - [Exidy] - Arcade - (1975)
snippet.description:
Name: Destruction Derby
Developer: Exidy
Year: 1975
Simulation : Not Available/ 2 players.
Platform:  ARCADE


Destruction Derby is a game in which a number of cars in an arena crash into each other until they are wrecked. The last remaining car is the winner. Cars are controlled with steering wheels and a foot pedal. Matches last one to two minutes. The game can be played by one or two players.
